title: Jolly Malty Croatian Lardons Hash
description: A malty, light, and quick-fix Croatian dish featuring sriracha and lardons-render, perfect for a dairy-free friendly meal. This dish is made with simple ingredients and can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the crispy lardons, malted barley flour, sriracha sauce, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is heated through.
Serve the Jolly Malty Croatian Lardons Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Prepare a fried or poached egg to serve on top, if desired.
Toast some crusty bread to serve on the side, if desired.
